api_note: Extension contract only; unchanged schemas/openapi.json covers the original executable profile.
publish_rule: Only bind a result to the active matching request identity. Obsolete responses remain accessible in their revision history but cannot overwrite the active view.

states.draft: Last confirmed results remain labelled out of date.
states.invalid: Field-linked errors; no overwrite of last valid query.
states.queued_or_running: Show stage and verified progress, never final zero.
states.partial: Show verified and unprocessed scopes separately.
states.complete_with_unresolved: Computation finished; evidence uncertainty remains independent.
states.complete_empty: No accepted patients in the completely searched scope.
states.failed_or_cancelled: Show reason and last confirmed result.
states.access_revoked: Remove protected content; do not disclose patient existence.

membership_delta: Compute by stable patient or episode identifiers only across comparable snapshots, population and semantics; otherwise label non-comparable.
near_match_application: Create a new draft revision, then revalidate all hard constraints and execute across target scope. Never edit patient records or invent evidence.
privacy: Authorized server autosave; in-memory unsent draft on disconnect; no persistent browser patient cache, public telemetry, session replay or automatic patient payloads to AI providers.
